# Maya by Janet Xiu Shi

> Maya is the AI-powered digital twin of Janet Xiu Shi, an Ireland-based Strategic AI and Cloud Advisor, Industry Lecturer, and AI Educator specialising in AI governance, AI quality and evaluation, and cloud strategy.

Janet Xiu Shi brings 20+ years across enterprise SaaS quality, procurement, and technology advisory, and lectures in cloud, generative AI, and web application development in Irish higher education and national workforce programmes.

Maya is designed for transparency: AI disclosure at first interaction, opt-in GDPR consent-based logging, EU (Ireland) log storage, and automatic 90-day deletion. Chat is available without logging.
